content:
We need DBE for C15H13O3Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). No N. Halogen Cl counts as H. So effective H = H + halogens = 13 +1 =14. DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 15 - 14/2 +1 = 15 -7 +1 =9. So integer 9.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for verification.
